articles.title: Bitcoin hit bottom at $59,000 marking end to the crypto winter, says Standard Chartered analyst
articles.snippet: Senior market analyst Geoffrey Kendrick pointed to the SpaceX IPO and a potential U.S.-Iran peace deal as the dual catalysts ending the recent crypto selloff.

articles.title: Former SEC, CFTC Chair Gary Gensler argues that prediction markets don't overrule state regulations
articles.snippet: The former regulator joined a number of interest groups in arguing that prediction markets are overstepping their bounds by offering sports-related contracts.

articles.title: Exodus launches tokenized stock marketplace with Ondo, adds 200-plus onchain equities
articles.snippet: The launch comes as tokenized equities surge in popularity, with crypto exchanges and wallets racing to offer onchain access to stocks and pre-IPO companies.

articles.title: Citi launches blockchain marketplace for shares of private companies: Report
articles.snippet: The US banking giant's blockchain marketplace will offer tokenized depositary receipts of private company shares amid Wall Street's broad embrace of tokenized assets.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton, BNP Paribas see tokenization boosting EU's capital efficiency
articles.snippet: Executives from Franklin Templeton and BNP Paribas say tokenized assets and stablecoins could improve capital efficiency across Europe as Wall Street expands tokenization efforts.
